## Key Engineering Projects
- [Distributed Computing System for Heterogeneous Computers](https://github.com/AnishUdupaN/MajorProject): Master-slave distributed task orchestrator routing workloads across mixed LAN hardware using real-time resource telemetry and hardware acceleration, with automatic failover and load balancing.
- Autonomous E-Commerce Price Tracker: Python + Playwright + cloak-browser scraping daemon scheduled via randomized systemd timers with local-LLM decoy queries and Firebase Cloud Messaging alerts to Android.
- [Secure Enterprise File Viewer](https://github.com/AnishUdupaN/MiniProjectServer): FastAPI backend and Android client preventing document leaks through OS-level screenshot blocking, ephemeral in-memory rendering, payload encryption, and device-bound token authorization.
